scope: 40 senses drawn at random (seed 20260902) from census 005, re-read under the census-003/004 reader rubric - the version WITHOUT the 'What is NOT a fault' section - to test whether that section caused the 0.0%

entries.definition: intellectually appealing
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The warmest of these - it treats appeal to the intellect as refinement rather than plain substance.

entries.definition: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Pushes the showing towards touch, so the thing is felt as much as seen — heavier in the hand than *apparent*.

entries.definition: showing or characterized by broad-mindedness
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Understated almost to neutrality — the same approval as *broad-minded* with the force stripped out of it.

entries.definition: without comfort
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: States a lack rather than a hurt — the bleakness sits in what is missing, which makes it colder than *uncomfortable*.

entries.definition: having an acceptable credit rating
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A quiet nod at financial standing, softer and less procedural-sounding than *creditworthy* though it settles the same question.

entries.definition: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Plain and unemphatic: the thing is simply there to be seen, with none of the display *manifest* makes of it.

entries.definition: manifesting partiality
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flat and administrative: it records that partiality is in play and leaves untouched the question *discriminatory* settles against it.
examples: a preferential shop gives priority or advantage to union members in hiring or promoting

entries.definition: not modified or restricted by reservations
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal and absolute, it presents the missing reservations as terms deliberately not imposed rather than as *flat*'s curt refusal to entertain them.

entries.definition: endowed with the capacity to reason
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Neutral in the way *reasoning* is, marking the capacity as a plain attribute rather than a merit.

entries.definition: having mythical elements removed
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flatly descriptive - records that the mythical element is gone without approving or regretting its removal.

entries.definition: capable of thinking and expressing yourself in a clear and consistent manner
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise at its lowest setting: the thought holds together and comes out clear, a floor cleared rather than the brightness *lucid* claims.
examples: she was more coherent than she had been just after the accident

entries.definition: concerning or belonging to all or at least two or more nations
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Neutral and minimal in its demand — two nations are enough to satisfy it, where *global* asks for the whole earth.

entries.definition: worthy of trust or belief
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain, unhedged verdict of the family - approval stated flatly, with no warmth or ceremony added to it.
examples: an experienced and trustworthy traveling companion

entries.definition: no longer existing or inaccessible through loss or destruction
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Technical and dry - marks the thing as gone through loss or destruction and judges nothing about it.
examples: its nonextant original was written on vellum

entries.definition: endowed with the capacity to reason
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely descriptive - states that the faculty is present and stops, extending none of the credit *intelligent* does for it.

entries.definition: making great mental demands; hard to comprehend or solve or believe
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Labels the demanding thing a problem outright, a mild verdict against it where *tough* only reports the demand.

entries.definition: conforming to fact and therefore worthy of belief
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The belief is earned by checking out against the facts, so the praise is for genuineness rather than for any goodwill.
examples: an authentic account by an eyewitness

entries.definition: requiring more than usually expected or thought due; especially great patience and effort and skill
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Plain and unheated - it names the size of what is asked without ruling on whether asking it is fair, where *hard-to-please* has already convicted someone.
examples: a baby can be so demanding

entries.definition: close in relevance or relationship
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plain measure of nearness in relevance or relationship, stating the proximity without the warmth or the suspicion the rest of the set add.
examples: we are all … in close sympathy with …

entries.definition: ready to entertain new ideas
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Plain and unpretentious, asking no more than a willingness to hear the new idea out.

entries.definition: not having existence or being or actuality
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flat and absolute - the thing simply has no being, without the sense in *missing* that it was expected somewhere.

entries.definition: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Works by ruling out the alternative: the thing cannot be read as anything else, a firmer guarantee than *apparent* gives.

entries.definition: characterized by malice
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plainest word for malice, stating the ill will flatly where *hateful* makes it sound monstrous.

entries.definition: open and observable; not secret or hidden
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plain everyday word for the same state, weightless where *overt* sounds like a term of art.

entries.definition: with no effort to conceal
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt - concealment is not just absent but conspicuously unattempted, and the missing softening reads as harshness.

entries.definition: about average; acceptable
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Cool and measuring — it grants acceptability and stops there, withholding the warmth *fine* carries.
examples: more than adequate as a secretary

entries.definition: of laws and regulations; designed to protect trade and commerce from unfair business practices
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Technical and as neutral as *antimonopoly*, marking a regulation's protective purpose rather than approving anybody's conduct.

entries.definition: influenced by or advocating internationalism
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The longer form, stiffer and more label-like than *internationalist* without adding to the stance it names.

entries.definition: mental or emotional as opposed to physical in nature
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The workaday technical term here, sorting a thing by what it is in nature rather than, as *psychogenic* does, by where it came from.

entries.definition: exhibiting or calling for sportsmanship or fair play
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most casual of these, informal and light, granting the same approval with none of *sportsmanlike*'s weight.
examples: a sporting solution of the disagreement

entries.definition: extremely pleasing
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Slangy and clipped - the same top-of-the-scale praise as *fabulous*, tossed off rather than declared.

entries.definition: relating to bodily unease that causes discomfort
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The faintest of these: a bodily unsettledness that has not hardened into pain, more a hint than a hurt.

entries.definition: being satisfactory or in satisfactory condition
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Breezy slang whose bounce overshoots the modest thing it reports — all is in order, announced as though it were a delight.

entries.definition: making great mental demands; hard to comprehend or solve or believe
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Informal and almost respectful of the difficulty - it sizes up the mental demand as something to be taken on and says nothing against it.

entries.definition: capable of pleasing
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: All-purpose and colourless - it grants no more than the capacity to please, where *pleasing* reports pleasure actually given.

entries.definition: making great mental demands; hard to comprehend or solve or believe
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The difficulty is in the slipping away: comprehension seems within reach and will not close on it, unlike the frank obstruction of *knotty*.

entries.definition: having a high price
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Weightier than *high-priced*, the price felt as a cost borne rather than a number quoted.

entries.definition: of or associated with or requiring the use of the mind
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Faintly flattering, since calling something intellectual credits it with demanding real thought, where *mental* says no more than that the mind was involved.

entries.definition: held dear
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain word for holding dear, stating the fact of the feeling without measuring its heat, where *adored* measures nothing else.
examples: his loved companion of many years

entries.definition: promoting or enhancing well-being
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and firmly approving — it credits the thing with actually improving matters, where *advantageous* only counts the edge gained.
examples: an arms limitation agreement beneficial to all countries
the beneficial effects of a temperate climate
